frame.title: A failed model conquered eight disciplines
frame.dek: Scholarly publications using the Prisoner's Dilemma framework grew from one paper in 1950 to over two thousand by 1975 — twenty-five years after Flood and Dresher's first experiment falsified its central prediction.
